column1:
The Ordos continue to grow in strength, thanks to their acquisition of new weaponry.  The Ordos know that the wrath of the Harkonnen will soon fall upon them, and have allied with the Atreides.  This will not protect them from our Atomics.  Eliminate any Atreides you encounter, but focus upon the Ordos as the main target.  Smash their army, burn their structures and bring back the spoils to decorate the walls of the Palace! Capturing or destroying the Ordos Palace will show the Atreides the true might of House of Harkonnen and will throw the Ordos allegiance into disarray. 

 Our scouts report a Mercenary leader inspecting a nearby Heavy Factory. If the Heavy Factory can be captured, the Mercenaries could be persuaded to fight for the Harkonnen. The mercenaries receive reinforcements via the Starport, so this must remain in their possession for them to be of any use.

Objective: Eliminate the Ordos. A description of the forces available to you follows.
column2: 奥多斯凭借新获得的武器持续壮大。他们知道哈肯尼的怒火即将降临，已与亚崔迪结盟——但我们的原子武器不会因此放过他们。遇到亚崔迪部队一律消灭，但主攻目标仍是奥多斯。碾碎他们的军队、焚毁他们的建筑，把战利品带回来装饰宫殿的墙壁！占领或摧毁奥多斯宫殿，将向亚崔迪展示哈肯尼家族的真正实力，并让奥多斯的联盟土崩瓦解。\n斥候报告，一名雇佣兵首领正在附近的重工厂视察。若能占领该重工厂，或许可以说服雇佣兵为哈肯尼而战。雇佣兵经由星际港获得增援，因此星际港必须留在他们手中才有用。\n目标：消灭奥多斯。以下为可用兵力说明。

column1:
Harvest Spice from the Imperial Basin. Construct a Spice Refinery and defend it against the Harkonnen troops scattered throughout the basin. You have been assigned only limited offensive forces - use them wisely. 

You will have to learn the subtleties of mining as you go, but remember to build Silos to store the Spice. When you run out of storage space you will lose all unstored Spice. Also, any building without adequate concrete foundation will need immediate repair and be vulnerable to erosive damage from the harsh environment. Your greatest adversary may be the elements. 

Objective: Harvest 2500 Solaris worth of Spice. Good luck. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2:
在帝国盆地采集香料。建造香料精炼厂，并抵御散布在盆地各处的哈肯尼部队。你只获配有限的进攻兵力——请善加使用。
你需要在实践中掌握采集的要领，但切记建造筒仓储存香料：储存空间不足时，所有未入库的香料都会损失。另外，任何没有足够混凝土地基的建筑都需要立即修理，并会遭受严酷环境的侵蚀伤害。你最大的对手也许是大自然。
目标：采集价值 2500 太阳币的香料。祝你好运。
可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

Refined Spice is automatically distributed among the Silos and Refineries for storage. A refinery can store 2000 spice.  A Spice Harvester is delivered via Carryall once a Refinery is built. 

Armor :  Medium.  Refineries are vulnerable to most types of weapons.
column2: 需求：风力陷阱\n用途：精炼厂是厄拉科斯香料生产的核心。采集车把香料运回精炼厂并转化为资金，精炼后的香料会自动分配到筒仓与精炼厂储存。一座精炼厂可储存 2000 单位香料；建成后会有运载机送来一台香料采集车。\n护甲：中型。精炼厂易受大多数武器伤害。

column1:
Requires : Refinery 

Purpose : The Spice Silo allows the player to store 1500 harvested Spice.  When a Refinery completes processing, excess Spice is automatically distributed evenly among the Silos and Refineries.  When harvested Spice exceeds Silo capacity, the excess will be lost.  When Spice Silos are destroyed or captured, the amount stored will be dispersed among other Silos and Refineries unless there is insufficient storage capacity. 

Armor : Light.  The Spice Silo is vulnerable to most types of weapons.
column2: 需求：精炼厂\n用途：香料筒仓可储存 1500 单位已采集香料。精炼完成后，多余香料会自动平均分配到筒仓与精炼厂。储量超过筒仓容量时，超出部分会损失。筒仓被摧毁或被占领时，其中储量会转移到其他筒仓与精炼厂；若容量不足则会损失。\n护甲：轻型。香料筒仓易受大多数武器伤害。

column1:
The weak Ordos are no match for Harkonnen troops.  However, smuggled Ixian technologies may upset this balance of power.  This cannot be allowed to happen.  Establish a base on the plain, locate the Ordos Starport and destroy or capture it before the expensive shipments of Ixian weaponry begin to arrive.  Time is short - the transports have already entered the system.  

Objective: Destroy the Starport. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 软弱的奥多斯绝非哈肯尼部队的对手，但走私进来的伊克斯科技可能打破力量平衡，绝不能坐视。在平原上建立基地，找到奥多斯星际港，并在昂贵的伊克斯武器开始运抵前将其摧毁或占领。时间紧迫——运输舰已进入星系。\n目标：摧毁星际港。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
Protect the Outpost at Habbanya to prevent Imperial interference.  Rush ground troops through the mountain passes and secure our Outpost.  Once this is done, turn on the Ordos and crush them. 

Objective: Destroy the Ordos.
column2: 保护哈巴尼亚的前哨站，阻止帝国干涉。该前哨站经过专门改装，用于探测太空中皇帝的舰船，必须守住。派地面部队穿过山口迅速夺回前哨站，完成后调头粉碎奥多斯。\n目标：摧毁奥多斯。

column1:
The weak Ordos are no match for Harkonnen troops.  However, smuggled Ixian technologies may upset this balance of power.  This cannot be allowed to happen.  Establish a base on the plain, locate the Ordos Starport and destroy or capture it before the expensive shipments of Ixian weaponry begin to arrive.  Time is short - the transports have already entered the system.  

Objective: Destroy the Starport.
column2: 软弱的奥多斯绝非哈肯尼部队的对手，但走私进来的伊克斯科技可能打破力量平衡，绝不能坐视。在平原上建立基地，找到奥多斯星际港，并在昂贵的伊克斯武器开始运抵前将其摧毁或占领。时间紧迫——运输舰已进入星系。\n目标：摧毁星际港。

column1: High Tech Factory neutralized! Atreides temporarily cut off from Imperial reinforcement!
column2: 高科技工厂已被瘫痪！亚崔迪暂时失去帝国增援！

column1:
Requires : Barracks 

Weapon : Light Infantry are lightly armored foot soldiers, equipped with 9mm RP assault rifles.  Light Infantry are effective against other infantry and lightly armored vehicles. 

Range : Short 

Speed : 16  km/h (foot) 

Armor : Light.  Light Infantry are resistant to missiles and large caliber guns, but very vulnerable to high explosives, fire and bullet weapons.
column2:
需求：兵营
武器：轻步兵是装备 9 毫米 RP 突击步枪的轻装甲步兵，对其他步兵和轻装甲载具有效。
射程：短
速度：16 千米/时（步行）
护甲：轻型。对导弹与大口径火炮有抗性，但极易被高爆、火焰与子弹武器杀伤。

column1:
Requires : Upgraded Light Factory 

Weapon : Stronger than the Trike in both armor and firepower, the Quad is a four-wheeled vehicle firing armor-piercing rockets.  The Quad is effective against most vehicles. 

Range: Short 

Speed: 54 km/h 

Armor: Light.  Quads are resistant to bullets and high explosives, to a lesser degree.  However, Quads are vulnerable to missiles and high caliber guns.
column2:
需求：升级后的轻工厂
武器：四轮炮车在装甲与火力上都强于三轮车，发射穿甲火箭弹，对大多数载具有效。
射程：短
速度：54 千米/时
护甲：轻型。对子弹与高爆武器有一定抗性，但易受导弹和大口径火炮伤害。

column1:
Requires : Nothing (Built by Mobile Construction Vehicle) 

Purpose : The Construction Yard is the foundation of any base built on Arrakis.  Construction Yards produce a small amount of power and are required for the building of any new structures.  Protect this structure!  It is critical to the success of your base. 

Armor :  Medium.  Construction yards are fairly strong, but vulnerable in varying degrees to all types of weapons.
column2: 需求：无（由机动建造车展开）\n用途：建造场是在厄拉科斯建立基地的根基，可提供少量电力，也是建造任何新建筑的前提。务必保护它——它关系到基地的成败。\n护甲：中型。建造场相当坚固，但对各类武器都有不同程度的弱点。

column1:
Requires : Construction Yard 

Purpose : If buildings are not placed on concrete, they will be damaged. Buildings can be repaired, but unless the building sits completely on concrete, the building will suffer continual weathering damage from the erosive desert environment. 

Armor : Medium.  Concrete is vulnerable to most weapon types.  Concrete cannot be repaired if damaged.
column2: 需求：建造场\n用途：建筑若未放置在混凝土地基上会受损。建筑可以修理，但只要没有完全坐落在混凝土上，就会持续遭受沙漠环境的侵蚀伤害。\n护甲：中型。混凝土易受大多数武器伤害，且受损后无法修理。

column1:
Requires : Wind Trap 

Purpose : Barracks are required to produce and train light infantry units.  Barracks can be upgraded for the production of more advanced infantry in later missions. 

Armor : Medium.  Barracks are vulnerable to most types of weapons.
column2: 需求：风力陷阱\n用途：兵营用于生产和训练轻步兵，在后期任务中可升级以生产更先进的步兵。\n护甲：中型。兵营易受大多数武器伤害。

column1:
Requires : Wind Trap 

Purpose : Base defense.  Concrete walls are the most effective barriers on Dune.  Concrete walls will block tank bullets and impede unit movement. 

Armor :  Medium.  Walls can only be damaged by explosive weapons, missiles and shells.  Like concrete slabs, walls cannot be repaired if damaged.
column2: 需求：风力陷阱\n用途：基地防御。混凝土墙是沙丘上最有效的屏障，可阻挡坦克炮弹并阻碍单位通行。\n护甲：中型。只有爆炸武器、导弹与炮弹能损伤城墙；与混凝土地板一样，受损后无法修理。

column1:
Requires : Barracks 

Purpose : If the player has sufficient power, the Radar Outpost will generate a radar map.  Radar is automatically activated when construction of the Outpost is complete.  

Armor :  Medium. The Radar Outpost is vulnerable to most types of weapons.
column2: 需求：兵营\n用途：电力充足时，雷达前哨站会生成雷达地图，建成后雷达自动启用。\n护甲：中型。雷达前哨站易受大多数武器伤害。

column1:
Requires : Refinery 

Purpose : The Light Factory is required for the production of small, lightly armored, combat vehicles. The Light Factory can be upgraded to produce more advanced light vehicles in later missions. 

Armor : Medium.  A Light Factory is vulnerable to most types of weapons.
column2: 需求：精炼厂\n用途：轻工厂用于生产小型轻装甲战斗载具，在后期任务中可升级以生产更先进的轻型载具。\n护甲：中型。轻工厂易受大多数武器伤害。

column1:
Requires : Barracks 

Purpose : Base defense. The Gun Turret has a medium range gun which is effective against vehicles, especially heavily armored vehicles. The Gun Turret will fire on any enemy unit within range.  

Armor : Medium.  The Gun Turret is resistant to bullet and explosive weapons, but vulnerable to missiles and high-caliber guns.
column2: 需求：兵营\n用途：基地防御。炮塔装备中程火炮，对载具、尤其是重装甲载具效果显著，会自动攻击射程内任何敌方单位。\n护甲：中型。对子弹与爆炸武器有抗性，但易受导弹和大口径火炮伤害。

column1:
Requires : Refinery 

Purpose : The Heavy Factory allows the player to build heavy vehicles such as Harvesters and Combat Tanks.  When upgraded, this facility allows the construction of advanced vehicles, though some vehicles also require other buildings. 

Armor : Heavy. The Heavy Factory is vulnerable to most types of weapons.
column2: 需求：精炼厂\n用途：重工厂可建造采集车、战斗坦克等重型载具；升级后可生产先进载具，但部分载具还需要其他建筑。\n护甲：重型。重工厂仍易受大多数武器伤害。

column1:
Requires : Atreides Palace 

Weapon: Fremen are the native desert warriors of Dune.  Fremen ground units carry 10mm Assault Rifles and Rockets.  Their firepower is equally effective against infantry and vehicles. 

Range: Medium. 

Speed: 16 km/h (on foot) 

Armor: Medium.  Fremen units are very vulnerable to high explosive and bullet weapons.
column2:
需求：亚崔迪宫殿
武器：弗雷曼人是沙丘的原生沙漠战士，携带 10 毫米突击步枪与火箭弹，对步兵和载具同样有效。
射程：中
速度：16 千米/时（步行）
护甲：中型。弗雷曼部队极易被高爆与子弹武器杀伤。

column1:
Requires : Light Factory 

Weapon: Raiders are similar to Trikes, but the Ordos have refined their fire power, speed and armor to create a powerful and maneuverable  scout.  With dual 20mm cannons, Raiders are most effective against infantry and lightly armored vehicles. 

Range: short 

Speed: 84 km/h 

Armor: Light.  Raiders are vulnerable to most types of weaponry, though high caliber guns are slightly less effective.
column2:
需求：轻工厂
武器：突击者与三轮车类似，但奥多斯改良了火力、速度与装甲，使其成为威力强、机动性高的侦察单位。双联 20 毫米机炮对步兵和轻装甲载具最为有效。
射程：短
速度：84 千米/时
护甲：轻型。易受大多数武器伤害，大口径火炮的效果略弱。

column1:
Requires : Heavy Factory 

Weapon: The Combat Tank is effective against most vehicles, less so against lightly armored vehicles. 

Range: Medium 

Speed: 40 km/h 

Armor: Medium. Combat Tanks are very resistant to bullet and heavy explosives, but vulnerable to missiles and high caliber guns. This intelligence applies to the Atreides tank. The Harkonnen is stronger but slower and the Ordos faster but weaker.
column2:
需求：重工厂
武器：战斗坦克对大多数载具有效，对轻装甲载具效果稍弱。
射程：中
速度：40 千米/时
护甲：中型。对子弹与重型高爆武器抗性很强，但易受导弹和大口径火炮伤害。以上数据针对亚崔迪坦克：哈肯尼坦克更强但更慢，奥多斯坦克更快但更弱。

column1:
Requires : Upgraded High Tech Factory 

Weapon: The fastest aircraft on Dune, the Ornithopther is lightly armored and capable of dropping 500lb bombs.  This unit is most effective against infantry and lightly armored targets, but also damages armored targets. 

Range:  N/A 

Speed: 168 km/h 

Armor: They are vulnerable to missiles and can only be hit by anti-aircraft weapons.
column2:
需求：升级后的高科技工厂
武器：扑翼机是沙丘上最快的飞行器，装甲轻薄，可投掷 500 磅炸弹，对步兵和轻装甲目标最有效，也能损伤装甲目标。
射程：无
速度：168 千米/时
护甲：易受导弹攻击，且只有防空武器能命中。

column1:
Requires : Harkonnen Palace 

 Purpose : The Death Hand Missiles' warhead carries atomic cluster munitions. It detonates above the target, inflicting great damage over a wide area. 

Range : N/A 

Speed: 280 km/h 

Armor: N/A.
column2:
需求：哈肯尼宫殿
用途：死亡之手导弹的弹头装载原子集束弹药，在目标上方引爆，对大范围造成巨大伤害。
射程：无
速度：280 千米/时
护甲：无。

column1:
Requires : Ix Research Center 

Purpose :  The Palace serves as the command center once it is constructed.  Palaces feature unique additional options, making available advanced special weapons. 

Armor : Heavy - but the Palace is vulnerable to most types of weapons.
column2: 需求：伊克斯研究中心\n用途：宫殿建成后即为指挥中心，各家族的宫殿提供独有的特殊武器选项。\n护甲：重型，但宫殿仍易受大多数武器伤害。

column1:
Requires : Upgraded Heavy Factory and Ix Research Center. 

Weapon:  It is anti-aircraft capable and effective against most targets, except infantry units. 

Range:  Long 

Speed: 36  km/h 

Armor: Medium.  Missile Tanks are vulnerable to most weapons, though high caliber guns are slightly less effective.
column2:
需求：升级后的重工厂与伊克斯研究中心
武器：导弹坦克具备防空能力，对除步兵外的大多数目标有效。
射程：长
速度：36 千米/时
护甲：中型。易受大多数武器伤害，大口径火炮的效果略弱。

column1:
Requires : Heavy Factory and Ix Research Center 

Weapon: Sound. The Sonic Tank is most effective against infantry and lightly armored vehicles - but weaker against armored targets. 

Range:  Medium 

Speed: 12 km/h 

Armor:  Medium. They are very resistant to bullets and high explosives, but vulnerable to missiles and high caliber guns. 

Note :   The Sonic Tank will damage all units in its firing path.
column2:
需求：重工厂与伊克斯研究中心
武器：声波。音波坦克对步兵和轻装甲载具最有效，对装甲目标较弱。
射程：中
速度：12 千米/时
护甲：中型。对子弹与高爆武器抗性很强，但易受导弹和大口径火炮伤害。
注：音波坦克会伤害其射线路径上的所有单位。

column1:
Requires : Heavy Factory and Ix Research Center 

Weapon: The Devastator is the most powerful tank on Dune - powerfully effective against most units, but slow - and slow to fire.  Nuclear powered, the Devastator fires dual plasma charges and may be ordered to self-destruct, damaging surrounding units and structures.  

Range:  Medium 

Speed: 12  km/h 

Armor: The Devastator is very resistant to bullet and high explosives, but vulnerable to missiles and high caliber guns.
column2:
需求：重工厂与伊克斯研究中心
武器：毁灭者是沙丘上最强大的坦克，对大多数单位威力极强，但速度慢、射速也慢。它以核能为动力，发射双联等离子弹，并可下令自毁，重创周围的单位与建筑。
射程：中
速度：12 千米/时
护甲：对子弹与高爆武器抗性很强，但易受导弹和大口径火炮伤害。

column1:
Requires : Heavy Factory 

Weapon : None 

Range : N/A  

Speed : 12 km/h 

Armor: Heavy.  Harvesters are resistant to bullets, and to some degree, high explosives. These units are vulnerable to missiles and high caliber guns. 

Note : A Harvester is included with a Refinery.
column2:
需求：重工厂
武器：无
射程：无
速度：12 千米/时
护甲：重型。采集车对子弹有抗性，对高爆武器也有一定抗性，但易受导弹和大口径火炮伤害。
注：建造精炼厂时会附赠一台采集车。

column1:
Requires : Construction Yard 

Purpose : Wind Traps provide power and water to an installation.  Large, above-ground ducts funnel wind currents underground into massive turbines which power generators and humidity extractors. 

Armor :  Light.  Wind Traps are vulnerable to most types of weapons.
column2: 需求：建造场\n用途：风力陷阱为基地提供电力与水。地面上的巨型管道把气流引入地下涡轮，驱动发电机与湿度提取器。\n护甲：轻型。风力陷阱易受大多数武器伤害。

column1:
Requires : Outpost and Upgraded Heavy Factory 

Purpose : The Ix Research Center provides technology upgrades for structures and vehicles.  This facility is required for production of a number of advanced special weapons and prototypes.  

Armor : Light.  The Ix Research Center is vulnerable to most types of weapons.
column2: 需求：前哨站与升级后的重工厂\n用途：伊克斯研究中心为建筑与载具提供科技升级，是生产多种先进特殊武器与原型机的前提。\n护甲：轻型。伊克斯研究中心易受大多数武器伤害。

column1:
Requires : Upgraded Heavy Factory 

Weapon:   Siege Tanks are very effective against infantry and lightly armored vehicles - but very weak against heavily armored targets. 

Range:  Long  

Speed: 30 km/h 

Armor: Heavy.  Siege Tanks are resistant to bullets, and to some degree, high explosives. These units are vulnerable to missiles and high caliber guns.
column2:
需求：升级后的重工厂
武器：攻城坦克对步兵和轻装甲载具非常有效，但对重装甲目标很弱。
射程：长
速度：30 千米/时
护甲：重型。对子弹有抗性，对高爆武器也有一定抗性，但易受导弹和大口径火炮伤害。

column1:
Requires : Upgraded Construction Yard and Outpost 

Purpose : Base defense. The substantially improved Rocket Turret has a longer range and a higher rate of fire than the Gun Turret. The Rocket Turret's advanced targeting equipment requires power to operate. 

Armor : Heavy.  The Rocket Turret is resistant to bullet and explosive weapons, but vulnerable to missiles and high caliber guns.
column2: 需求：升级后的建造场与前哨站\n用途：基地防御。大幅改良的火箭炮塔比普通炮塔射程更远、射速更快，其先进瞄准设备需要电力才能运作。\n护甲：重型。对子弹与爆炸武器有抗性，但易受导弹和大口径火炮伤害。

column1:
Requires : Upgraded Barracks 

Weapon : Armed with missile launchers, Troopers fire wire guided armor-piercing warheads.  These units are particularly effective against vehicles (especially armored ones) and buildings.  However, this unit is largely useless against infantry. 
Range: Medium 

Speed: 12  km/h (on foot) 

Armor: Light.  Troopers are resistant to anti-tank weaponry but very vulnerable to high explosives, fire and bullet weapons.
column2:
需求：升级后的兵营
武器：火箭兵装备导弹发射器，发射线导穿甲弹头，对载具（尤其装甲载具）与建筑特别有效，但对步兵几乎无用。
射程：中
速度：12 千米/时（步行）
护甲：轻型。对反坦克武器有抗性，但极易被高爆、火焰与子弹武器杀伤。

column1:
Requires : Heavy Factory and Repair Pad 

Weapon: None.  The Mobile Construction Vehicle must be driven to a suitable deployment area.  After locating an appropriate area of rock, the MCV can be transformed into a Construction Yard. 

Speed: 12  km/h 

Armor: Medium.  MCVs are resistant to bullets and some high explosives. They are vulnerable to missiles and high caliber guns.
column2:
需求：重工厂与维修坪
武器：无。机动建造车须驶往合适的展开地点，找到平整岩地后可变形为建造场。
速度：12 千米/时
护甲：中型。对子弹与部分高爆武器有抗性，但易受导弹和大口径火炮伤害。

column1:
Requires : Upgraded Barracks 

Weapon: None. Engineers can be used to capture enemy buildings. 

Range: N/A 

Speed: 12 km/h 

Armor: Light.  Engineers are resistant to anti-tank weaponry but very vulnerable to high explosives, fire and bullet weapons.
column2:
需求：升级后的兵营
武器：无。工程师可用于占领敌方建筑。
射程：无
速度：12 千米/时
护甲：轻型。对反坦克武器有抗性，但极易被高爆、火焰与子弹武器杀伤。

column1:
Infiltrate the Imperial Basin and build up our forces until they are strong enough to eradicate the local Harkonnen presence.  The Harkonnen are reinforcing their troops by air, so be on your guard.  Use the Outpost's radar to detect attacks from unexpected quarters. 

Be careful when mining the Spice.  Spice mounds grow out of the sand.  While a vital source of Spice, Spice mounds can damage or destroy any unit that blunders into them. 

Objective: Destroy all Harkonnen forces.  Good luck. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2:
潜入帝国盆地并扩充兵力，直到足以肃清当地哈肯尼势力。哈肯尼正通过空运增兵，务必警戒。利用前哨站的雷达侦测来自意料之外方向的袭击。
采集香料时要小心：香料丘会从沙中隆起。它虽是重要的香料来源，但任何误入其中的单位都可能受损甚至被摧毁。
目标：摧毁所有哈肯尼部队。祝你好运。
可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
Bring the Atreides forces up to combat strength - quickly. Guard against surprise attacks and ensure Spice production. The Ordos forces are light but numerous. To combat the Ordos, you have been granted license to produce Quads, which have a greater anti-vehicle capability than Trikes.  Upgrade your Light Factories to allow production of these units. Meet any aggression with overwhelming force. 

Objective: Harvest 5000 Solaris worth of Spice. Good luck. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 迅速让亚崔迪部队达到战斗状态。防范突袭，保障香料生产。奥多斯部队装备轻但数量众多。为对抗奥多斯，你已获准生产四轮炮车——其反载具能力强于三轮车。升级轻工厂即可生产该单位。以压倒性火力回击任何挑衅。\n目标：采集价值 5000 太阳币的香料。祝你好运。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
Our scouts have discovered the hidden Fremen base.  The Harkonnen blockade of the Fremen must be broken.  Powerful Harkonnen forces to the South are massing for an assault on the Fremen.  Heavy forces have been allocated to you to smash through the Harkonnen fortifications and come to the aid of the Fremen. 

Objective: Protect the Fremen Sietch. Destroy the Harkonnen.  Good luck. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 斥候已发现弗雷曼人的隐蔽基地。必须打破哈肯尼对弗雷曼的封锁。南方强大的哈肯尼部队正在集结，准备进攻弗雷曼。你已获配重装部队，用于突破哈肯尼工事并驰援弗雷曼。\n目标：保护弗雷曼穴地，摧毁哈肯尼。祝你好运。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
According to our spies, the Fremen are being held at the far Northwest corner of Sietch Tabr.  Push your way through the Harkonnen ranks to rescue the hostages.  Scout the terrain before you launch the main assault. Our Engineers must reach the Barracks, and capture it intact.  The rest of the base can be razed to the ground. Additionally, there are rumors of an illegal Smuggling operation in the area.  A large shipment of contraband is expected at the Smuggler's Starport. If you can capture the Starport before the contraband arrives, you will be able to confiscate it for the Atreides war effort. Be warned, the Smugglers have Mercenary allies who may assist them if you interfere. 

Objective: Capture the Barracks at Sietch Tabr. Good luck. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2:
据密报，弗雷曼人被关押在塔布尔穴地最西北角。突破哈肯尼阵线救出人质。发动主攻前先侦察地形。你的工程师必须抵达兵营并将其完整占领，基地其余部分可夷为平地。
此外，有传言称该地区存在非法走私活动，一批大宗违禁品即将抵达走私者的星际港。若能在货物到达前占领星际港，即可将其没收充作亚崔迪的军资。注意：走私者与雇佣兵结盟，一旦干预，他们可能出手相助。
目标：占领塔布尔穴地的兵营。祝你好运。
可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
The Ordos strength grows in the Funeral Plain - reinforcements are pouring in through the Smuggler base.  Strike the base quickly, before fortifications grow too strong.  Destroy the Starport to cut the Ordos off from re-supply, then eradicate the remaining Ordos forces. 

Objective: Crush all Ordos forces. Good luck. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 奥多斯在葬礼平原的势力日渐壮大，增援正源源不断经走私者基地抵达。趁其工事尚未坚固，迅速打击该基地。摧毁星际港以切断奥多斯的补给，随后肃清残余奥多斯部队。\n目标：击溃所有奥多斯部队。祝你好运。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
The Harkonnen have pulled back.  Now is the time for the decisive blow.  Seek out the cowards and turn their retreat into a rout.  Do not let them consolidate their position.  Our most advanced weaponry is at your disposal for this momentous attack.  Build it and use it well. 

Objective: Destroy House Harkonnen.  Good Luck. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 哈肯尼已经后撤，现在正是给予决定性一击的时机。找出这些懦夫，把撤退变成溃败，不要让他们稳住阵脚。此战你可动用最先进的武器，好好建造、好好使用。\n目标：摧毁哈肯尼家族。祝你好运。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
Although the battle was costly, the Emperor was forced to retreat.  Use this respite from Imperial assault to annihilate the Ordos.  Do not stop until all Ordos are dead and their base destroyed. 

Once a Palace is constructed, Fremen can be summoned and will fight alongside House Atreides.  Use their desert skills wisely. 

Objective: Destroy all forces that oppose you. Good luck. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2:
此战代价惨重，但皇帝被迫退却。利用这段免遭帝国进攻的喘息时机歼灭奥多斯，不达目的绝不罢休：所有奥多斯人都得死，他们的基地必须被摧毁。
宫殿建成后可召唤弗雷曼人，他们会与亚崔迪家族并肩作战，善用他们的沙漠技艺。
目标：摧毁一切与你为敌的部队。祝你好运。
可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
The arrival of the Imperial forces has thrown our troops into disarray. Our base of operations has been divided. Only two Atreides enclaves have survived the confusion of the initial assault. Rally our troops, regroup and engage the combined Harkonnen and Imperial forces. Our last chance for victory rests with you. Long live the fighters! 

Objective: Eliminate everyone! Good luck. 

No new forces available.
column2: 帝国军的抵达使我军陷入混乱，作战基地被分割，最初的突袭中只有两处亚崔迪飞地幸存。集结部队、重整旗鼓，迎战哈肯尼与帝国联军。最后的胜机就握在你手中。战士们万岁！\n目标：消灭所有人！祝你好运。\n本关无新增兵力。

column1:
Mine the Spice from the Imperial Basin, before the Atreides try to seize the area.  Execute anyone who tries to stop you. 

Build Silos to store the Spice.  Remember to place buildings on concrete foundations to prevent erosion and gradual decline.  To build without concrete would be inefficient.  Inefficiency will not be tolerated. 

Objective: Mine 2500 Solaris worth of Spice. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2:
抢在亚崔迪夺取帝国盆地之前开采香料。任何阻拦者，一律处决。
建造筒仓储存香料。切记把建筑放在混凝土地基上，以免侵蚀与日渐衰损；不打地基就建造是低效的，而低效不可容忍。
目标：开采价值 2500 太阳币的香料。
可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
Strengthen your forces at our mining camp in the Imperial Basin.  We must punish the Atreides for their insolence.  Teach them the consequences of opposing House Harkonnen.  Our radar will help you find your targets. 

Objective: Destroy the Atreides. 

A description of new units and structures available can be accessed below.
column2: 在帝国盆地的采矿营地扩充兵力。必须惩罚亚崔迪的傲慢，让他们明白对抗哈肯尼家族的后果。雷达会帮你找到目标。\n目标：摧毁亚崔迪。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
Attack and destroy the Atreides base at Sietch Tabr.  Strike hard and eliminate all resistance. 

Heavier Quad vehicles will be made available for your attack.  Upgrade your Light Factory to gain access to these vehicles. 

Objective: Crush the Atreides forces. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2:
进攻并摧毁亚崔迪在塔布尔穴地的基地。狠狠打击，肃清一切抵抗。
此战将配发更重型的四轮炮车。升级轻工厂即可获得该载具。
目标：击溃亚崔迪部队。
可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
The native Fremen must be dealt with.  Assemble a strike force to lead a sweep through the mountains.  Seek out the Fremen hold, and destroy it.  If any House responds, destroy it.  Tanks have been deployed to grind the Fremen beneath their treads.  Demonstrate the power of House Harkonnen. 

Objective: Annihilate all hostile forces. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 必须处理掉本地的弗雷曼人。组建突击队扫荡山区，找出弗雷曼据点并摧毁它；若有任何家族出面响应，一并消灭。坦克已部署到位，将把弗雷曼人碾在履带之下。展示哈肯尼家族的力量。\n目标：歼灭所有敌对部队。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
Your target is the Atreides High Tech factory, the weak link of the Duke's plan to combine with the Imperial Troops.  Without it, the Imperial Carryalls will soon fall into disrepair and not be able to ferry further reinforcements to the battle. The Atreides force is large and well-fortified - a frontal assault will fail.  However, one Construction Yard to the East of their position is isolated and lightly defended.  A small strike force has been airlifted deep into enemy territory.  Capture the Construction Yard and use it against the Atreides. 

Objective: Destroy all Harkonnen enemies. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 你的目标是亚崔迪高科技工厂——公爵联合帝国军计划中的薄弱环节。失去它，帝国的运载机很快就会失修，无法再运送增援。亚崔迪兵力庞大、工事坚固，正面强攻必然失败。不过其阵地以东有一座孤立且防守薄弱的建造场。一支小股突击队已空投深入敌后：占领那座建造场，用它反过来对付亚崔迪。\n目标：摧毁所有哈肯尼之敌。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
Only the Atreides and Imperial forces now remain.  The Sardaukar, still scattered from their long march from the North, cannot mass their forces to attack.  Only the destruction of the Emperor's base encampment will stop the flow of Imperial forces.  Once this has been accomplished, turn on the Atreides and annihilate them. Claim Arrakis for House Harkonnen! 

Objective: Destroy all our enemies. 

No new forces available.
column2: 如今只剩亚崔迪与帝国军。萨多卡军团长途跋涉自北方而来，队形散乱，尚无法集结进攻。只有摧毁皇帝的基地营地才能阻止帝国军源源涌入。完成这一步后，掉头歼灭亚崔迪，为哈肯尼家族拿下厄拉科斯！\n目标：摧毁所有敌人。\n本关无新增兵力。

column1:
Spice is wealth. Serve the Ordos by harvesting Spice in the Imperial Basin. If Harkonnen forces attempt to interrupt the flow of the Spice - neutralize them.  Efficiency dictates that Silos must be built to avoid loss of Spice.  Build concrete foundations to avoid unnecessary damage from the elements.  To do otherwise is wasteful. 

Objective: Collect 2500 Solaris worth of Spice. That is the mission. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 香料即财富。为奥多斯效力，在帝国盆地采集香料。若哈肯尼部队试图截断香料运输，就清除他们。效率要求必须建造筒仓以免香料损失，也必须铺设混凝土地基以避免环境造成无谓损伤；否则即是浪费。\n目标：收集价值 2500 太阳币的香料。这就是任务。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
Harkonnen forces are weakened in the Imperial Basin.  Use the sensors in our Outpost to find them.  Strike hard and destroy everything.  

Objective: Destroy all buildings.  Leave nothing alive. That is the mission. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 哈肯尼部队在帝国盆地兵力薄弱。利用前哨站的传感器找到他们，狠狠打击，摧毁一切。\n目标：摧毁所有建筑，不留活口。这就是任务。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
The Harkonnen hinder the production of Spice.  A Harkonnen attack will disrupt efficient production.  Inefficiency cannot be tolerated.  The Harkonnen must be eliminated. New weapons are available - the Quads.  Newer weapons are more powerful.  Powerful weapons ensure victory. 

Objective: Eliminate the Harkonnen.  That is the mission. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 哈肯尼妨碍香料生产，其进攻会打乱高效生产——低效不可容忍，哈肯尼必须被清除。新武器四轮炮车已可用；越新的武器越强大，强大的武器确保胜利。\n目标：消灭哈肯尼。这就是任务。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
The Smugglers at Sietch Tabr must be neutralized.  Capture the Outpost where their families have taken shelter as insurance.  The children's lives will assure the loyalties of their fathers. Use an Engineer to enter and capture the building.  The Smugglers' new partners, the Harkonnen, may attempt to protect them.  Harkonnen firepower is great, but we have recently acquired tanks that may counter this. Ensure our investment is used wisely. 

Objective:  Capture the Outpost at Sietch Tabr. That is the mission. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 必须清除塔布尔穴地的走私者。占领其家属避难的前哨站作为筹码——孩子们的性命将保证父亲的忠诚。派工程师进入并占领该建筑。走私者的新伙伴哈肯尼可能出手保护，其火力强大，但我们新获得的坦克足以抗衡。务必让这笔投资物有所值。\n目标：占领塔布尔穴地的前哨站。这就是任务。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
Spice is paramount.  The Atreides possess the Spice.  We must capture their Starport and bring in an MCV to construct a base to harvest the Spice.  Combat is costly.  Fight only if the Atreides obstruct the flow of Spice.  Use the minimum amount of funds for defense. Mine and store what is needed to pay our debt to the Ixians. Once that amount has been collected - Ordos forces will withdraw. 

Objective: Mine and store 15000 Solaris worth of Spice.  That is the mission. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 香料高于一切。亚崔迪占据着香料，我们必须占领他们的星际港，运入一辆机动建造车建立基地开采香料。战斗代价高昂，只有在亚崔迪阻碍香料运输时才交战，并以最少的资金用于防御。开采并储存偿还伊克斯人债务所需的数额，一旦收齐，奥多斯部队即行撤离。\n目标：开采并储存价值 15000 太阳币的香料。这就是任务。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
The Starport must be protected.  All other efforts are secondary.  No House will be allowed to interfere with the arrival of our Ixian weaponry. Once we possess these illegal technologies, we will confuse and crush our opponents.  Until then, survive.  This will give you a higher probability of success. 

Objective:  Defend the Starport and destroy our enemies.   That is the mission. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 必须守住星际港，其余一切都是次要的。任何家族都不得干扰伊克斯武器的运抵。一旦掌握这些违禁技术，我们就能迷惑并碾碎对手；在那之前，活下去——这会提高成功概率。\n目标：保卫星际港并摧毁敌人。这就是任务。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
Our hired mercenaries will counter the numerical superiority of the Atreides and Imperial forces.  They fight for money but they are a fragile investment.  Defend their base and protect their forces as they attack - or they will desert our cause.  

Objective: Destroy the Emperor - and his Atreides lap dogs. That is the mission. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2: 我们雇佣的雇佣兵将抵消亚崔迪与帝国军的数量优势。他们为钱而战，却是一项脆弱的投资。守住他们的基地，在他们进攻时提供掩护，否则他们会背弃我们。\n目标：消灭皇帝——以及他那些亚崔迪走狗。这就是任务。\n可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
The Atreides and Harkonnen are supported by our deceitful Emperor.  They shelter in the ridges to the East.  Our mercenaries will engage them. Again, the hired soldiers will desert if they sustain too many casualties.  Watch for their treachery. With or without them, House Ordos must triumph. 

 Spies report increasing Atreides troop movements in the region. Use the information wisely. 

Objective:  Eradicate all hostile forces. That is the mission. 

A description of new units and structures available to build can be accessed below.
column2:
亚崔迪与哈肯尼都得到背信弃义的皇帝支持，藏身于东面的山脊。我们的雇佣兵将与其交战；同样，一旦伤亡过大，这些雇来的士兵就会逃散，提防他们的背叛。无论有没有他们，奥多斯家族都必须获胜。
密探报告该地区亚崔迪部队调动日益频繁，善用这份情报。
目标：肃清所有敌对部队。这就是任务。
可在下方查看本关新增可建造单位与建筑的说明。

column1:
Three weakened armies remain standing in the way of our success.  All must be destroyed to complete the victory of House Ordos. 

Objective:  Finish it. That is the mission. 

 No new forces available.
column2: 三支元气大伤的军队仍挡在我们通往胜利的道路上。必须全部摧毁，才能完成奥多斯家族的凯旋。\n目标：了结这一切。这就是任务。\n本关无新增兵力。

column1:
Harvest Spice from the Imperial Basin. Construct a Spice Refinery and defend it against the Harkonnen troops scattered throughout the basin. You have been assigned only limited offensive forces. Use them wisely. 

You will have to learn the subtleties of mining as you go, but remember to build Silos to store the Spice. When you run out of storage space you will lose all unstored Spice. Also, any building without adequate concrete foundation will need immediate repair and be vulnerable to erosive damage from the harsh environment. Your greatest adversary may be the elements. 

Objective: Harvest 2500 Solaris worth of Spice. Good luck.
column2: 在帝国盆地采集香料。建造香料精炼厂，并抵御散布在盆地各处的哈肯尼部队。你只获配有限的进攻兵力——请善加使用。\n你需要在实践中掌握采集的要领，但切记建造筒仓储存香料：储存空间不足时，所有未入库的香料都会损失。另外，任何没有足够混凝土地基的建筑都需要立即修理，并会遭受严酷环境的侵蚀伤害。你最大的对手也许是大自然。\n目标：采集价值 2500 太阳币的香料。祝你好运。

column1:
Infiltrate the Imperial Basin and build up our forces until they are strong enough to eradicate the local Harkonnen presence.  The Harkonnen are reinforcing their troops by air, so be on your guard.  Use the Outpost's radar to detect attacks from unexpected quarters. 

Be careful when mining the Spice.  Spice mounds grow out of the sand.  While a vital source of Spice, Spice mounds can damage or destroy any unit that blunders into them. 

Objective: Destroy all Harkonnen forces.  Good luck.
column2: 潜入帝国盆地并扩充兵力，直到足以肃清当地哈肯尼势力。哈肯尼正通过空运增兵，务必警戒。利用前哨站的雷达侦测来自意料之外方向的袭击。\n采集香料时要小心：香料丘会从沙中隆起。它虽是重要的香料来源，但任何误入其中的单位都可能受损甚至被摧毁。\n目标：摧毁所有哈肯尼部队。祝你好运。

column1:
Bring the Atreides forces up to combat strength - quickly. Guard against surprise attacks and ensure Spice production. The Ordos forces are light but numerous. To combat the Ordos, you have been granted license to produce Quads, which have a greater anti-vehicle capability than Trikes.  Upgrade your Light Factories to allow production of these units. Meet any aggression with overwhelming force. 

Objective: Harvest 5000 Solaris worth of Spice. Good luck.
column2: 迅速让亚崔迪部队达到战斗状态。防范突袭，保障香料生产。奥多斯部队装备轻但数量众多。为对抗奥多斯，你已获准生产四轮炮车——其反载具能力强于三轮车。升级轻工厂即可生产该单位。以压倒性火力回击任何挑衅。\n目标：采集价值 5000 太阳币的香料。祝你好运。

column1:
Our scouts have discovered the hidden Fremen base.  The Harkonnen blockade of the Fremen must be broken.  Powerful Harkonnen forces to the South are massing for an assault on the Fremen.  Heavy forces have been allocated to you to smash through the Harkonnen fortifications and come to the aid of the Fremen. 

Objective: Protect the Fremen Sietch. Destroy the Harkonnen.  Good luck.
column2: 斥候已发现弗雷曼人的隐蔽基地。必须打破哈肯尼对弗雷曼的封锁。南方强大的哈肯尼部队正在集结，准备进攻弗雷曼。你已获配重装部队，用于突破哈肯尼工事并驰援弗雷曼。\n目标：保护弗雷曼穴地，摧毁哈肯尼。祝你好运。

column1:
According to our spies, the Fremen are being held at the far Northwest corner of Sietch Tabr.  Push your way through the Harkonnen ranks to rescue the hostages.  Scout the terrain before you launch the main assault. Our Engineers must reach the Barracks and capture it intact.  The rest of the base can be razed to the ground. 

Additionally, there are rumors of an illegal Smuggling operation in the area.  A large shipment of contraband is expected at the Smuggler's Starport. If you can capture the Starport before the contraband arrives, you will be able to confiscate it for the Atreides war effort. Be warned, the Smugglers have Mercenary allies who may assist them if you interfere. 

Objective: Capture the Barracks at Sietch Tabr. Good luck.
column2: 据密报，弗雷曼人被关押在塔布尔穴地最西北角。突破哈肯尼阵线救出人质。发动主攻前先侦察地形。你的工程师必须抵达兵营并将其完整占领，基地其余部分可夷为平地。\n此外，有传言称该地区存在非法走私活动，一批大宗违禁品即将抵达走私者的星际港。若能在货物到达前占领星际港，即可将其没收充作亚崔迪的军资。注意：走私者与雇佣兵结盟，一旦干预，他们可能出手相助。\n目标：占领塔布尔穴地的兵营。祝你好运。

column1:
The Ordos strength grows in the Funeral Plain - reinforcements are pouring in through the Smuggler base.  Strike the base quickly, before fortifications grow too strong.  Destroy the Starport to cut the Ordos off from re-supply, then eradicate the remaining Ordos forces. 

Objective: Crush all Ordos forces. Good luck.
column2: 奥多斯在葬礼平原的势力日渐壮大，增援正源源不断经走私者基地抵达。趁其工事尚未坚固，迅速打击该基地。摧毁星际港以切断奥多斯的补给，随后肃清残余奥多斯部队。\n目标：击溃所有奥多斯部队。祝你好运。

column1:
The Harkonnen have pulled back.  Now is the time for the decisive blow.  Seek out the cowards, and turn their retreat into a rout.  Do not let them consolidate their position.  Our most advanced weaponry is at your disposal for this momentous attack.  Build it and use it well. 

Objective: Destroy House Harkonnen.  Good Luck.
column2: 哈肯尼已经后撤，现在正是给予决定性一击的时机。找出这些懦夫，把撤退变成溃败，不要让他们稳住阵脚。此战你可动用最先进的武器，好好建造、好好使用。\n目标：摧毁哈肯尼家族。祝你好运。

column1:
Although the battle was costly, the Emperor was forced to retreat.  Use this respite from Imperial assault to annihilate the Ordos.  Do not stop until all Ordos are dead and their base destroyed. 

Once a Palace is constructed, Fremen can be summoned and will fight alongside House Atreides.  Use their desert skills wisely. 

Objective: Destroy all forces that oppose you. Good luck.
column2: 此战代价惨重，但皇帝被迫退却。利用这段免遭帝国进攻的喘息时机歼灭奥多斯，不达目的绝不罢休：所有奥多斯人都得死，他们的基地必须被摧毁。\n宫殿建成后可召唤弗雷曼人，他们会与亚崔迪家族并肩作战，善用他们的沙漠技艺。\n目标：摧毁一切与你为敌的部队。祝你好运。

column1:
The arrival of the Imperial forces has thrown our troops into disarray. Our base of operations has been divided. Only two Atreides enclaves have survived the confusion of the initial assault. Rally our troops, regroup and engage the combined Harkonnen and Imperial forces. Our last chance for victory rests with you. Long live the fighters! 

Objective: Eliminate everyone! Good luck.
column2: 帝国军的抵达使我军陷入混乱，作战基地被分割，最初的突袭中只有两处亚崔迪飞地幸存。集结部队、重整旗鼓，迎战哈肯尼与帝国联军。最后的胜机就握在你手中。战士们万岁！\n目标：消灭所有人！祝你好运。

column1:
Mine the Spice from the Imperial Basin, before the Atreides try to seize the area.  Execute anyone who tries to stop you. 

Build Silos to store the Spice.  Remember to place buildings on concrete foundations to prevent erosion and gradual decline.  To build without concrete would be inefficient.  Inefficiency will not be tolerated. 

Objective: Mine 2500 Solaris worth of Spice.
column2: 抢在亚崔迪夺取帝国盆地之前开采香料。任何阻拦者，一律处决。\n建造筒仓储存香料。切记把建筑放在混凝土地基上，以免侵蚀与日渐衰损；不打地基就建造是低效的，而低效不可容忍。\n目标：开采价值 2500 太阳币的香料。

column1:
Strengthen your forces at our mining camp in the Imperial Basin.  We must punish the Atreides for their insolence.  Teach them the consequences of opposing House Harkonnen.  Our radar will help you find your targets. 

Objective: Destroy the Atreides.
column2: 在帝国盆地的采矿营地扩充兵力。必须惩罚亚崔迪的傲慢，让他们明白对抗哈肯尼家族的后果。雷达会帮你找到目标。\n目标：摧毁亚崔迪。

column1:
Attack and destroy the Atreides base at Sietch Tabr.  Strike hard and eliminate all resistance. 

Heavier Quad vehicles will be made available for your attack.  Upgrade your Light Factory to gain access to these vehicles. 

Objective: Crush the Atreides forces.
column2: 进攻并摧毁亚崔迪在塔布尔穴地的基地。狠狠打击，肃清一切抵抗。\n此战将配发更重型的四轮炮车。升级轻工厂即可获得该载具。\n目标：击溃亚崔迪部队。

column1:
The native Fremen must be dealt with.  Assemble a strike force to lead a sweep through the mountains.  Seek out the Fremen hold, and destroy it.  If any House responds, destroy it.  Tanks have been deployed to grind the Fremen beneath their treads.  Demonstrate the power of House Harkonnen. 

Objective: Annihilate all hostile forces.
column2: 必须处理掉本地的弗雷曼人。组建突击队扫荡山区，找出弗雷曼据点并摧毁它；若有任何家族出面响应，一并消灭。坦克已部署到位，将把弗雷曼人碾在履带之下。展示哈肯尼家族的力量。\n目标：歼灭所有敌对部队。

column1:
Your target is the Atreides Hi-Tech factory, the weak link of the Duke's plan to combine with the Imperial Troops.  Without it, the Imperial Carryalls will soon fall into disrepair and not be able to ferry further reinforcements to the battle.  The Atreides force is large and well-fortified - a frontal assault will fail.  However, one Construction Yard to the East of their position is isolated and lightly defended.  A small strike force has been airlifted deep into enemy territory.  Capture the Construction Yard and use it against the Atreides. 

Objective: Destroy all Harkonnen enemies.
column2: 你的目标是亚崔迪高科技工厂——公爵联合帝国军计划中的薄弱环节。失去它，帝国的运载机很快就会失修，无法再运送增援。亚崔迪兵力庞大、工事坚固，正面强攻必然失败。不过其阵地以东有一座孤立且防守薄弱的建造场。一支小股突击队已空投深入敌后：占领那座建造场，用它反过来对付亚崔迪。\n目标：摧毁所有哈肯尼之敌。

column1:
Only the Atreides and Imperial forces now remain.  The Sardaukar, still scattered from their long march from the North, cannot mass their forces to attack.  Only the destruction of the Emperor's base encampment will stop the flow of Imperial forces.  Once this has been accomplished, turn on the Atreides and annihilate them. Claim Arrakis for House Harkonnen! 

Objective: Destroy all our enemies.
column2: 如今只剩亚崔迪与帝国军。萨多卡军团长途跋涉自北方而来，队形散乱，尚无法集结进攻。只有摧毁皇帝的基地营地才能阻止帝国军源源涌入。完成这一步后，掉头歼灭亚崔迪，为哈肯尼家族拿下厄拉科斯！\n目标：摧毁所有敌人。

column1:
Spice is wealth. Serve the Ordos by harvesting Spice in the Imperial Basin. If Harkonnen forces attempt to interrupt the flow of the Spice - neutralize them.  Efficiency dictates that Silos must be built to avoid loss of Spice.  Build concrete foundations to avoid unnecessary damage from the elements.  To do otherwise is wasteful. 

Objective: Collect 2500 Solaris worth of Spice. That is the mission.
column2: 香料即财富。为奥多斯效力，在帝国盆地采集香料。若哈肯尼部队试图截断香料运输，就清除他们。效率要求必须建造筒仓以免香料损失，也必须铺设混凝土地基以避免环境造成无谓损伤；否则即是浪费。\n目标：收集价值 2500 太阳币的香料。这就是任务。

column1:
Harkonnen forces are weakened in the Imperial Basin.  Use the sensors in our Outpost to find them.  Strike hard and destroy everything.  

Objective: Destroy all buildings.  Leave nothing alive. That is the mission.
column2: 哈肯尼部队在帝国盆地兵力薄弱。利用前哨站的传感器找到他们，狠狠打击，摧毁一切。\n目标：摧毁所有建筑，不留活口。这就是任务。

column1:
The Harkonnen hinder the production of Spice.  A Harkonnen attack will disrupt efficient production.  Inefficiency cannot be tolerated.  The Harkonnen must be eliminated. New weapons are available - the Quads.  Newer weapons are more powerful.  Powerful weapons ensure victory. 

Objective: Eliminate the Harkonnen.  That is the mission.
column2: 哈肯尼妨碍香料生产，其进攻会打乱高效生产——低效不可容忍，哈肯尼必须被清除。新武器四轮炮车已可用；越新的武器越强大，强大的武器确保胜利。\n目标：消灭哈肯尼。这就是任务。

column1:
The Smugglers at Sietch Tabr must be neutralized.  Capture the Outpost where their families have taken shelter as insurance.  The children's lives will assure the loyalties of their fathers. Use an Engineer to enter and capture the building.  The Smugglers' new partners, the Harkonnen, may attempt to protect them.  Harkonnen firepower is great, but we have recently acquired tanks that may counter this. Ensure our investment is used wisely. 

Objective:  Capture the Outpost at Sietch Tabr. That is the mission.
column2: 必须清除塔布尔穴地的走私者。占领其家属避难的前哨站作为筹码——孩子们的性命将保证父亲的忠诚。派工程师进入并占领该建筑。走私者的新伙伴哈肯尼可能出手保护，其火力强大，但我们新获得的坦克足以抗衡。务必让这笔投资物有所值。\n目标：占领塔布尔穴地的前哨站。这就是任务。

column1:
Spice is paramount.  The Atreides possess the Spice.  We must capture their Starport and bring in an MCV to harvest the Spice.  Combat is costly.  Fight only if the Atreides obstruct the flow of Spice.  Use the minimum amount of funds for defense. Mine and store what is needed to pay our debt to the Ixians. Once that amount has been collected - Ordos forces will withdraw. 

Objective: Mine and store 15000 Solaris worth of Spice.  That is the mission.
column2: 香料高于一切。亚崔迪占据着香料，我们必须占领他们的星际港，运入一辆机动建造车建立基地开采香料。战斗代价高昂，只有在亚崔迪阻碍香料运输时才交战，并以最少的资金用于防御。开采并储存偿还伊克斯人债务所需的数额，一旦收齐，奥多斯部队即行撤离。\n目标：开采并储存价值 15000 太阳币的香料。这就是任务。

column1:
The Starport must be protected.  All other efforts are secondary.  No House will be allowed to interfere with the arrival of our Ixian weaponry. Once we possess these illegal technologies, we will confuse and crush our opponents.  Until then, survive.  This will give you a higher probability of success. 

Objective:  Defend the Starport and destroy our enemies.   That is the mission.
column2: 必须守住星际港，其余一切都是次要的。任何家族都不得干扰伊克斯武器的运抵。一旦掌握这些违禁技术，我们就能迷惑并碾碎对手；在那之前，活下去——这会提高成功概率。\n目标：保卫星际港并摧毁敌人。这就是任务。

column1:
Our hired mercenaries will counter the numerical superiority of the Atreides and Imperial forces.  They fight for money but they are a fragile investment.  Defend their base and protect their forces as they attack - or they will desert our cause.  

Objective: Destroy the Emperor - and his Atreides lap dogs. That is the mission.
column2: 我们雇佣的雇佣兵将抵消亚崔迪与帝国军的数量优势。他们为钱而战，却是一项脆弱的投资。守住他们的基地，在他们进攻时提供掩护，否则他们会背弃我们。\n目标：消灭皇帝——以及他那些亚崔迪走狗。这就是任务。

column1:
The Atreides and Harkonnen are supported by our deceitful Emperor.  They shelter in the ridges to the East.  Our mercenaries will engage them. Again, the hired soldiers will desert if they sustain too many casualties.  Watch for their treachery. With or without them, House Ordos must triumph. 

 Spies report increasing Atreides troop movements in region. Use the information wisely.  

Objective:  Eradicate all hostile forces. That is the mission.
column2: 亚崔迪与哈肯尼都得到背信弃义的皇帝支持，藏身于东面的山脊。我们的雇佣兵将与其交战；同样，一旦伤亡过大，这些雇来的士兵就会逃散，提防他们的背叛。无论有没有他们，奥多斯家族都必须获胜。\n密探报告该地区亚崔迪部队调动日益频繁，善用这份情报。\n目标：肃清所有敌对部队。这就是任务。

column1:
Three weakened armies remain standing in the way of our success.  All must be destroyed to complete the victory of House Ordos. 

Objective:  Finish it. That is the mission.
column2: 三支元气大伤的军队仍挡在我们通往胜利的道路上。必须全部摧毁，才能完成奥多斯家族的凯旋。\n目标：了结这一切。这就是任务。
